t2.title: Volunteering be made compulsory for students
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should volunteering be made compulsory for students?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Compulsory volunteering for students is debated worldwide. I believe while volunteering has benefits, making it mandatory may undermine its value.

Firstly, volunteering teaches valuable life skills. Teamwork, empathy, and responsibility develop through community service. These experiences cannot be learned from textbooks alone.

Secondly, exposure to volunteering may spark lifelong civic engagement. Students who volunteer often continue as adults, benefiting society long-term.

However, forcing students could create resentment. Genuine altruism comes from choice, not obligation. Mandatory programs may produce reluctant volunteers who provide poor service.

Furthermore, some students have legitimate constraints – part-time jobs, family responsibilities, or health issues – making requirements unfair.

Nevertheless, schools should strongly encourage volunteering through incentives rather than mandates. Offering academic credit, recognition, and diverse opportunities can increase participation voluntarily.

In conclusion, while student volunteering is valuable, encouraging rather than forcing participation maintains authenticity and produces better outcomes for communities.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I help. It was good. I like it. I help people. It is fun. I want to help again. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I did volunteering. It was good because I helped people. The people were nice and the work was easy. I think other students should help too, but maybe not everyone wants to. It's good to help but it should be their choice. I liked the program and I want to do it again next year. Thank you!
t2.sampleB1:
Hi everyone,
I want to talk about volunteering for students. I think it is a good idea, but I'm not sure about making it compulsory. Volunteering can teach students important things, like how to work with others and how to help people in need. For example, I volunteered at a soup kitchen and it made me feel good to help.

However, if it is compulsory, some students might not enjoy it and they might not do a good job. Also, some students might have other things to do, like part-time jobs or family responsibilities. Maybe it would be better to encourage students to volunteer instead of forcing them. What do you think?
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, This is a great topic, and I've been mulling it over for a while. Should volunteering be compulsory for students? Personally, I'm in two minds about it. On the one hand, I can see the appeal. Volunteering teaches young people valuable life skills like teamwork and responsibility, which you simply can't pick up from textbooks. It also opens their eyes to problems in their community and can spark a lifelong habit of helping others. For students who would never try it otherwise, a gentle push might turn out to be a blessing in disguise. On the other hand, forcing people to volunteer feels like a contradiction in terms. If students only turn up because they have to, their hearts won't really be in it, and the people they are meant to help could end up worse off. On top of that, plenty of students already juggle part-time jobs and family duties. All in all, I think schools should strongly encourage volunteering rather than make it compulsory — perhaps with rewards or recognition. That way, students take part because they genuinely want to. What do you all think?
t2.uzSample:
Talabalar uchun majburiy volontyorlik butun dunyoda bahsga sabab bo'lmoqda. Menimcha, volontyorlikning foydalari bo'lsa-da, uni majburiy qilish uning qadrini pasaytirishi mumkin.

Birinchidan, volontyorlik qimmatli hayotiy ko'nikmalarni o'rgatadi. Jamoada ishlash, hamdardlik va mas'uliyat jamiyatga xizmat qilish orqali rivojlanadi. Bu tajribalarni faqat darsliklardan o'rganib bo'lmaydi.

Ikkinchidan, volontyorlik bilan tanishish umrbod fuqarolik faolligini uyg'otishi mumkin. Volontyor bo'lgan talabalar ko'pincha kattalar sifatida ham davom etishadi va jamiyatga uzoq muddatli foyda keltirishadi.

Biroq, talabalarni majburlash norozilikni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Haqiqiy altruizm majburiyatdan emas, balki tanlovdan kelib chiqadi. Majburiy dasturlar yomon xizmat ko'rsatadigan istamas volontyorlarni yetishtirishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, ba'zi talabalarda qonuniy cheklovlar mavjud – to'liqsiz ish, oilaviy majburiyatlar yoki sog'liq muammolari – bu talablarni adolatsiz qiladi.

Shunga qaramay, maktablar mandatlar o'rniga rag'batlantirish orqali volontyorlikni kuchli rag'batlantirishi kerak. Akademik kredit, e'tirof va turli xil imkoniyatlarni taklif qilish ixtiyoriy ravishda ishtirokni oshirishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, talabalar volontyorligi qimmatli bo'lsa-da, ishtirokni majburlashdan ko'ra rag'batlantirish, samimiylikni saqlaydi va jamiyatlar uchun yaxshiroq natijalarni beradi.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Men yordam beraman. Bu yaxshi edi. Menga yoqdi. Men odamlarga yordam beraman. Bu qiziqarli. Men yana yordam berishni xohlayman. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Men volontyorlik qildim. Bu yaxshi edi, chunki men odamlarga yordam berdim. Odamlar yaxshi edi va ish oson edi. Menimcha, boshqa talabalar ham yordam berishlari kerak, lekin balki hamma ham xohlamas. Yordam berish yaxshi, lekin bu ularning tanlovi bo'lishi kerak. Menga dastur yoqdi va men uni kelasi yili yana qilmoqchiman. Rahmat!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hammaga salom,
Men talabalar uchun volontyorlik haqida gapirmoqchiman. Menimcha, bu yaxshi fikr, lekin uni majburiy qilishga ishonchim komil emas. Volontyorlik talabalarga boshqalar bilan qanday ishlashni va muhtoj odamlarga qanday yordam berishni kabi muhim narsalarni o'rgatishi mumkin. Misol uchun, men bepul ovqat tarqatadigan oshxonada volontyor bo'ldim va bu menga yordam berganimdan xursand bo'ldim.

Biroq, agar u majburiy bo'lsa, ba'zi talabalarga bu yoqmasligi mumkin va ular yaxshi ish qilmasligi mumkin. Shuningdek, ba'zi talabalarning boshqa ishlari bo'lishi mumkin, masalan, yarim kunlik ishlar yoki oilaviy majburiyatlar. Ehtimol, talabalarni majburlash o'rniga, ularni volontyorlikka undash yaxshiroq bo'lar. Siz nima deb o'ylaysiz?
t2.uzSampleB2:
Talabalarni volontyorlikka majburlash kerakmi degan savol murakkab masala. Men potentsial foydalarni tan olsam ham, buni majburiy qilish oxir-oqibatda samarasiz bo'lishi mumkin deb hisoblayman.

Bir tomondan, volontyorlik shaxsiy o'sish uchun bebaho imkoniyatlarni taqdim etadi. Talabalar jamoada ishlash, muammolarni hal qilish va hamdardlik kabi muhim ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirishlari mumkin. Misol uchun, mahalliy jamoat bog'ida volontyorlik qilish tajribam menga turli xil kelib chiqishi bo'lgan odamlar bilan bog'lanish va barqaror hayotning ahamiyatini qadrlash imkonini berdi.

Biroq, talabalarni volontyorlikka majburlash norozilikni keltirib chiqarishi va altruizm ruhiga putur etkazishi mumkin. Istamagan volontyor samarali bo'lishi dargumon. Bundan tashqari, bunday talabni qo'yish akademik bosim yoki moliyaviy qiyinchiliklar bilan kurashayotgan talabalarga ortiqcha yuk bo'lishi mumkin. Ehtimol, yanada samaraliroq yondashuv - o'quvdan tashqari tan olish orqali volontyorlikni rag'batlantirish yoki jamiyatga xizmatni o'quv dasturiga mazmunli tarzda integratsiya qilish bo'lishi mumkin. Bu shunchaki majburiyatni bajarishdan ko'ra, jamiyatga hissa qo'shishga chinakam istakni uyg'otishi mumkin.

Yakuniy xulosa qilib aytganda, men majbur qilishdan ko'ra, ixtiyoriy ishtirokni rag'batlantirish yanada barqaror va axloqiy yondashuv deb hisoblayman.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who has free time and wants to do something meaningful. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I know you've got some free time and want to do something worthwhile. I recently volunteered with HelpHands and it was incredibly rewarding! Helping others really makes you feel good. You should definitely sign up – they have various programs to choose from! Take care!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Madina,
I help. It is good. You help too?
Bye.
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Madina,
I helped at HelpHands. It was good, and I liked it. You have time. You can help too because it is good for people. Maybe you like it.
See you soon!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Madina,
I wanted to tell you about my volunteering. I worked with HelpHands, and it was really good. I think you should do it too because you have free time. It's meaningful to help people. You can find different projects there. I think you would enjoy it.
Write back soon!
t11.sampleB2: Hey Madina, Guess what — I've finally found the perfect way for you to fill your free time! Last month I started volunteering with HelpHands, and honestly, it's been amazing. Helping out at the shelter made me feel like I was actually making a difference. You'd love it, so why not give it a go? I'm sure you'd get so much out of it. Let me know, Dilnoza Karimova
t11.uzSample:
Salom!

Bilaman, sening bo'sh vaqting bor va foydali bir ish qilmoqchisan. Men yaqinda HelpHands bilan ko'ngilli bo'lib ishladim va bu juda ham foydali bo'ldi! Boshqalarga yordam berish haqiqatan ham o'zingni yaxshi his qilishingga sabab bo'ladi. Sen albatta ro'yxatdan o'tishing kerak – ularda tanlash uchun turli xil dasturlar bor!

O'zingni asra!
t11.uzSampleA1:
Salom, Madina,
Men yordam beraman. Bu yaxshi. Siz ham yordam berasizmi?
Xayr.
t11.uzSampleA2:
Salom, Madina,
Men HelpHands tashkilotida yordam berdim. Bu yaxshi edi va menga yoqdi. Senda vaqt bor. Sen ham yordam berishing mumkin, chunki bu odamlar uchun yaxshi. Balki senga ham yoqar.
Tez orada ko'rishguncha!
t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom Madina,
Men sizga o'z ixtiyoriy ishim haqida aytmoqchi edim. Men HelpHands bilan ishladim va bu juda yaxshi edi. O'ylaymanki, siz ham buni qilishingiz kerak, chunki sizda bo'sh vaqt bor. Odamlarga yordam berish juda mazmunli. U yerda turli loyihalarni topishingiz mumkin. O'ylaymanki, sizga bu yoqadi.
Tez orada javob yozing!
t11.uzSampleB2:
Salom Madina,
Nima bo'lganini bilasanmi? Yaqinda men HelpHands bilan ko'ngilli bo'lib ishladim va o'z tajribamni sen bilan bo'lishmoqchiman. Sen bo'sh vaqtingni mazmunli biror narsaga sarflashni xohlayotganingni hisobga olsak, men ularni tekshirib ko'rishni tavsiya qilaman. Jamiyatga hissa qo'shish juda qoniqarli bo'ldi va menimcha, sen ham xuddi shunday mukofotlanasan. Ular turli xil imkoniyatlarni taklif qilishadi, shuning uchun sen o'zingga qiziqarli bo'lgan narsani topishing shubhasiz.
Fikringni menga bildir!
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Ozoda Salimova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the volunteering organization. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear HelpHands Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your volunteering program. I found the experience deeply fulfilling. The coordinators were extremely supportive and well-organized. Working with the community gave me a sense of purpose and helped me develop new skills. I made meaningful connections with fellow volunteers. However, I have some suggestions. The training session was rather brief for complex tasks. Additionally, flexible scheduling options would help volunteers with busy lives participate more. I would appreciate skills-based volunteering opportunities matching professional expertise. A recognition program for dedicated volunteers would boost motivation. Also, virtual volunteering options would expand participation. Overall, HelpHands provides valuable community service. Yours sincerely, Ozoda Salimova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi HelpHands,


I like help. It was good. The people are nice. I helped clean. It was fun. I want to help again. Thank you.


Bye,


Ozoda Salimova
t12.sampleA2:
Dear HelpHands,


Thank you for the letter. I liked the volunteering. The people were nice and I helped a lot. It was good because I like to help people. The leaders were good too. They helped me.


I think you can have more days to help. And maybe we can play games with the people we help. That would be fun.


Thank you again.


From,


Ozoda Salimova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear HelpHands Team,


Thank you for the opportunity to volunteer. I think it was a good experience. The coordinators were helpful and friendly. I felt like the work I did was important to the community, and that made me happy.


However, I think there could be some improvements. For example, it would be good to have more information before we start volunteering, like what to expect and what we need to bring. Also, maybe you could offer different kinds of volunteer work so people can choose what they are best at.


Overall, I enjoyed volunteering with HelpHands and I would recommend it to others.


Sincerely,


Ozoda Salimova
t12.sampleB2: Dear HelpHands Team, Thank you for your kind message following my time with the HelpHands Community Program. I am writing to share a few thoughts. Overall, I found the experience genuinely rewarding. Your coordinators were approachable and well-organised, and they supported us every step of the way. The work itself felt meaningful, and knowing that I was giving back to the community gave me a real sense of purpose. That said, I would like to suggest a couple of improvements. Firstly, the initial training was rather brief, so a longer session would help newcomers feel more confident. Secondly, offering more flexible scheduling would allow people with busy lives to take part more easily. Thank you once again for the opportunity, which I would gladly repeat in the future. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli HelpHands jamoasi,

Sizning ko'ngillilik dasturingizdagi tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Men bu tajribani juda foydali deb topdim. Koordinatorlar juda qo'llab-quvvatlovchi va yaxshi tashkil etilgan edi. Jamiyat bilan ishlash menga maqsad hissini berdi va yangi ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirishga yordam berdi. Men boshqa ko'ngillilar bilan mazmunli aloqalarni o'rnatdim.

Biroq, menda ba'zi takliflar bor. Murakkab vazifalar uchun trening mashg'uloti juda qisqa edi. Bundan tashqari, moslashuvchan jadval variantlari band hayot kechiradigan ko'ngillilarga ko'proq ishtirok etishga yordam beradi.

Men professional tajribaga mos keladigan ko'nikmalarga asoslangan ko'ngillilik imkoniyatlarini qadrlagan bo'lardim. Fidoyi ko'ngillilar uchun taqdirlash dasturi motivatsiyani oshiradi. Shuningdek, virtual ko'ngillilik variantlari ishtirokni kengaytiradi.

Umuman olganda, HelpHands qimmatli jamiyat xizmatini taqdim etadi.

Hurmat bilan,

Ozoda Salimova
t12.uzSampleA1:
Salom HelpHands,


Men yordam berishni yoqtiraman. Yaxshi bo'ldi. Odamlar yaxshi. Men tozalashga yordam berdim. Qiziqarli bo'ldi. Men yana yordam bermoqchiman. Rahmat.


Xayr,


Ozoda Salimova
t12.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli HelpHands,


Xat uchun rahmat. Menga volontyorlik yoqdi. Odamlar yaxshi edi va men ko'p yordam berdim. Bu yaxshi bo'ldi, chunki odamlarga yordam berishni yaxshi ko'raman. Rahbarlar ham yaxshi edi. Ular menga yordam berishdi.


O'ylaymanki, yordam berish uchun ko'proq kunlaringiz bo'lishi mumkin. Va balki biz yordam berayotgan odamlar bilan o'yinlar o'ynashimiz mumkin. Bu qiziqarli bo'lardi.


Yana bir bor rahmat.


Sizdan,


Ozoda Salimova
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli HelpHands jamoasi,


Ko'ngilli bo'lish imkoniyati uchun rahmat. Menimcha, bu yaxshi tajriba bo'ldi. Koordinatorlar yordam berishga tayyor va do'stona edilar. Men qilgan ishim jamiyat uchun muhimdek tuyuldi va bu meni xursand qildi.


Biroq, menimcha, ba'zi yaxshilanishlar bo'lishi mumkin. Misol uchun, ko'ngillilikni boshlashdan oldin ko'proq ma'lumotga ega bo'lish yaxshi bo'lardi, masalan, nimani kutish kerak va nima olib kelishimiz kerak. Shuningdek, odamlar o'zlari yaxshi bo'lgan narsani tanlashlari uchun turli xil ko'ngillilik ishlarini taklif qilishingiz mumkin.


Umuman olganda, men HelpHands bilan ko'ngilli bo'lishdan zavqlandim va buni boshqalarga ham tavsiya qilaman.


Hurmat bilan,


Ozoda Salimova
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli HelpHands jamoasi,


Mening yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan volontyorlik tajribam bo'yicha fikr-mulohazalaringiz uchun rahmat. HelpHands bilan o'tkazgan vaqtim asosan ijobiy va jamiyatga qimmatli hissa bo'ldi deb hisoblayman.


Tashkiliy tuzilma maqtovga loyiq edi va koordinatorlar dastur davomida yetarli yordam ko'rsatishdi. Ayniqsa, aniq aloqa va mening harakatlarim haqiqatan ham o'zgarishlarga olib kelayotganini his qilganim meni xursand qildi. Ishning o'zi mazmunli tuyuldi va dasturdan foydalanuvchilar bilan muloqot qilish menga yoqdi.


Biroq, menda bir nechta takliflar bor. Birinchidan, dastlabki brifing yanada kengroq bo'lishi mumkin edi, ayniqsa, potentsial qiyinchiliklar va ularni hal qilish strategiyalari bo'yicha. Ikkinchidan, turli xil rollarni taklif qilish turli xil ko'nikmalarga ega bo'lgan ko'proq ko'ngillilarni jalb qilishi mumkin. Ehtimol, ko'ngillilarning qiziqishlari va qobiliyatlarini baholash uchun so'rov o'tkazish mumkin.


Umuman olganda, men HelpHands ajoyib ish qilayotganiga ishonaman va umid qilamanki, mening fikr-mulohazalarim ko'ngillilik tajribasini yanada yaxshilashga yordam beradi.


Hurmat bilan,


Ozoda Salimova
